name: synthesize_speech
description: Turn text into a spoken-audio preview using the cloud TTS provider configured in Settings. Prefer the configured fast model for drafts and speed-sensitive work; use an HD or expressive model when the user prioritizes fidelity. The result is a transient local audio file and is not written into the workspace.

text.description: The exact text to speak. Do not add commentary that the user did not request.

model.description: Optional provider model override. Omit to use the configured model.

voice.description: Optional provider voice id override. Omit to use the configured voice.

speed.description: Optional speaking-rate multiplier. Omit to use the configured speed.

filename.description: Optional safe suggested filename for the transient preview.
